subject: Vendor activation steps — tax packet, bank details & PO initiation (CleverMFG)
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara@clevermfg.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor activation steps — tax packet, bank details & PO initiation (CleverMFG)

Hi Tara —

Welcome — excited to kick off the engagement. To get CleverMFG activated in our systems and issue a PO we need to collect a small set of procurement documents. Please submit the following items as separate PDF attachments or links: 

- Completed W-9 (if CleverMFG is a US entity) OR completed W-8BEN-E (if non-US)
- VAT registration certificate (if you charge VAT or are EU-based)
- Bank details for ACH / wire (account name, routing/IBAN, SWIFT) — we prefer a bank details form rather than inline text
- Signed vendor intake form (link below) and the billing contact for invoices

Link to our supplier intake form: https://redwood-internal.sharepoint.com/sites/procurement/vendor-intake-form

Once we have the tax form + bank details, Finance will validate and create PO-2026-987654. Typical turnaround is 3–5 business days after receiving complete docs. If any of the items above require a different format (e.g., DocuSign), let me know and we can accommodate.

CC'ing Neha (Procurement) and Lauren (Finance) for visibility.

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Vendor Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Tara Singh <tara@clevermfg.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:17:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Vendor activation steps — tax packet, bank details & PO initiation (CleverMFG)

Thanks Diego —

Quick questions before we send the paperwork: 

1) CleverMFG is incorporated in the UK and has a UK VAT number. Do you need a UK VAT certificate plus a W-8BEN-E?
2) Our finance team prefers to send bank details in a separate signed PDF for security — is that acceptable?
3) Who should the billing contact be on the intake form? We have an AP inbox (ap@clevermfg.com) and a billing manager (Tara Singh).

I've attached a short questionnaire with a few fields we couldn't find on your intake form (attachment: CleverMFG-Tax-Questionnaire.docx).

Best,
Tara Singh
Head of Finance Operations
CleverMFG Inc.

Hi Tara — thanks for the quick reply and the questionnaire — very helpful. Answers below: 

1) Yes — since CleverMFG is UK-incorporated, please provide a completed W-8BEN-E (not a W-9) and a VAT registration extract (PDF). Our AP team requires the W-8 for withholding documentation.

2) Separate signed PDF for bank details is perfect. Please label the file "CleverMFG-Bank-Details.pdf" and include an authorized signature. We will only use it for vendor setup; Finance will handle it securely.

3) Please put the billing contact as: Tara Singh <ap@clevermfg.com> and indicate whether invoices should be sent to ap@clevermfg.com or to your billing manager directly.

Attachment guidance: PDF preferred, otherwise DocuSign links are fine. 

Neha — can you confirm whether Procurement needs any additional onboarding fields (tax classification, commodity code) from CleverMFG?

Lauren — Finance will need the legal name and EIN/VAT number as shown on the tax form before issuing the PO.

Thanks —
Diego
Vendor Ops | Redwood Inference

Hi all — procurement side: we only need two additional items for our vendor profile:

- Commodity code (high-level description of goods/services)
- Expected monthly spend estimate (ballpark is fine)

Tara — could you add that to the intake form when you upload? Once the tax doc + bank stub are uploaded I will mark the vendor "Ready for PO" in our system.
